name: Camping 101: Cooking

angles.text: As a cook, you learn to kindle a campfire at the heart of a wilderness campsite.

faq.answer: Camping 101: Cooking teaches you to kindle a campfire and establish a campsite in the wilderness.
Zerril Softbreeze teaches cooking and campfire making in Shen'dar Village.
Cooking teaches you to kindle the campfire at the heart of a wilderness campsite.
faq.q: Why is cooking required to set up a camp?

faq.answer: Zerril Softbreeze is in Shen'dar Village.
A basic camp has few furnishings. Other tradeskills let you craft and set up more.
As your cooking skill improves, you can kindle larger campfires.

sections.body: A campfire gives you a place to rest in untamed lands. Learning to cook begins with making that fire. It is the first step toward establishing a safe campsite.
sections.title: The Hearth of the Wild

sections.body: Speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn the fundamentals of cooking. Once you know how to kindle a campfire, you can establish a small campsite in the wilderness. A basic camp has only a few furnishings. As your cooking skill improves, you can kindle larger fires. Other tradeskills help furnish the site.
sections.title: Foundations of the Campsite

summary: At Shen'dar Village, Zerril Softbreeze shows you how to kindle a campfire. Camping 101: Cooking teaches you to make a fire and establish a campsite in the wilderness.
